section.content: The invention discloses a preparation method of a water-based adhesive, the water-based adhesive and application thereof, wherein the water-based adhesive comprises a component A and a component B, the component A is a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl in a molecular formula, the component B is a micromolecular organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl in the molecular formula, the component A and the component B undergo condensation reaction to form a three-dimensional network structure, the mass ratio of the component A to the component B is (1:9) - (9:1), the water-based adhesive is used in a negative electrode of a lithium battery, the component B adsorbs a silicon-based negative electrode material of the negative electrode through hydrogen bonds and coats the surface of the silicon-based negative electrode material to form a passivation layer, and the water-based adhesive is used for preparing the negative electrode and assembling the negative electrode into the lithium battery, so that the first-week coulomb efficiency and the cycling stability of the lithium battery can be improved.

本发明公开了一种水系粘结剂的制备方法、水系粘结剂及其应用,水系粘结剂包括组分A和组分B；其中，组分A为分子式中含有羧基和羟基的聚合物；组分B为分子式中含有羧基或者羟基的小分子有机酸；组分A与组分B发生缩合反应形成三维网络结构；组分A与组分B的质量比为[1:9]‑[9:1]；水系粘结剂用于锂电池的负极中，组分B通过氢键吸附负极的硅基负极材料并包覆在硅基负极材料的表面形成钝化层；将本发明的水系粘结剂用于负极的制备并组装为锂电池，可以提高锂电池的首周库伦效率和循环稳定性。

Preparation method of water-based adhesive, water-based adhesive and application of water-based adhesiveTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery materials, in particular to a preparation method of a water-based adhesive, the water-based adhesive and application of the water-based adhesive.

Background

The silicon-based anode material can lead to the problems of pulverization of silicon particles, separation of electrode active substances and conductive particles and cracking of an electrode structure due to huge volume expansion in the circulation process, and aiming at the problems, researchers improve the problems by designing a novel silicon structure, developing a novel electrolyte, a binder and other methods.

The current commercial binder is mainly polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), the solvent N-methyl pyrrolidone (NMP) of the binder is toxic and volatile, and can pollute the environment, and the battery assembled by the polyvinylidene fluoride and the negative electrode prepared from the silicon-based negative electrode material has the defects of easy pulverization of silicon particles and poor battery cycle performance. Therefore, there is a need to develop new aqueous binders in place of PVDF.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a preparation method of a water-based adhesive, the water-based adhesive and application thereof, and aims to solve the problems that silicon particles are easy to pulverize, the circulation performance is poor and a solvent NMP adopted by the adhesive is toxic and easy to volatilize when the existing adhesive such as polyvinylidene fluoride is applied to a lithium battery of a silicon negative electrode material system.

To this end, in a first aspect, embodiments of the present invention provide an aqueous binder comprising component a and component B;

The component A is a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl in a molecular formula, and the component B is a small molecular organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl in the molecular formula;

the component A and the component B undergo condensation reaction to form a three-dimensional network structure;

The mass ratio of the component A to the component B is (1:9) - (9:1);

the water-based binder is used in a negative electrode of a lithium battery, and the component B adsorbs a silicon-based negative electrode material of the negative electrode through hydrogen bonds and coats the surface of the silicon-based negative electrode material to form a passivation layer.

Preferably, the component A specifically comprises one or more of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, polyacrylic acid, sodium alginate, polyvinyl alcohol and carboxymethyl chitosan.

Preferably, the component B comprises one or more of tartaric acid, citric acid, oxalic acid, fumaric acid, maleic acid and malic acid.

In a second aspect, an embodiment of the present invention provides a method for preparing the aqueous binder according to the first aspect, where the method includes:

Preparing the component A into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 1% -5%, then adding a certain amount of the component B, heating and stirring through a water bath, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution;

Placing the mixed solution into a container with a substrate of polytetrafluoroethylene, and drying in a vacuum drying oven to obtain a blocky precursor;

and (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

Preferably, the component A is a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl in the molecular formula, and specifically comprises one or more of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, polyacrylic acid, sodium alginate, polyvinyl alcohol and carboxymethyl chitosan

The component B is small molecular organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl in a molecular formula, and specifically comprises one or more of tartaric acid, citric acid, oxalic acid, fumaric acid, maleic acid and malic acid;

the mass ratio of the component A to the component B in the mixed solution is [1:9] - [9:1].

Preferably, the drying treatment is carried out under the conditions that the drying is carried out in a vacuum drying oven at 90-120 ℃ for 5-8 hours;

The heating and stirring conditions in the water bath are specifically that the heating temperature is 85-95 ℃ and the time is 6-10 hours.

In a third aspect, an embodiment of the present invention provides a negative electrode, where the negative electrode includes a negative electrode active material, the aqueous binder described in the first aspect, and a conductive agent.

Preferably, the anode active material is a silicon-based anode material, and specifically comprises any one of nano silicon, a silicon-carbon composite material and silicon oxide, wherein the conductive agent comprises one or more of acetylene black, carbon nano tubes, ketjen black, conductive graphite and graphene;

The mass percentage of the anode active material, the conductive agent and the water-based binder is [80% -95% ] [3% -10% ] [2% -10% ].

In a fourth aspect, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium battery, where the lithium battery includes a positive electrode, a negative electrode according to the third aspect, an electrolyte or a solid electrolyte, and a separator.

Preferably, the lithium battery comprises any one of a lithium ion battery, a lithium sulfur battery and an all-solid-state battery.

The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of a water-based adhesive, the water-based adhesive and application thereof, wherein a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl is mixed with a micromolecule organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl to generate condensation reaction to form a three-dimensional network structure, wherein the micromolecule organic acid generates adsorption action on silicon of a silicon-based negative electrode material through hydrogen bonds to realize the coating action on the silicon-based negative electrode material to form a passivation layer, so that the problem that the silicon in the silicon-based negative electrode material directly contacts with electrolyte to generate a solid electrolyte interface film (SEI) to influence the cycle performance is avoided or reduced.

The preparation method of the water-based adhesive provided by the embodiment of the invention is simple to operate, can be suitable for large-scale production, and has practical significance for industrialized application.

Drawings

The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention is further described in detail through the drawings and the embodiments.

Fig. 1 is a flowchart of a preparation method of an aqueous binder according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Detailed Description

The invention is described in further detail below with reference to the drawings and to specific examples, but it should be understood that these examples are for the purpose of more detailed description only and should not be construed as limiting the invention in any way, i.e. not as limiting the scope of the invention.

The embodiment of the invention provides a water-based adhesive, which comprises a component A and a component B;

The component A is a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl in a molecular formula, the component B is a micromolecular organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl in the molecular formula, the mass ratio of the component A to the component B is (1:9) - (9:1), preferably (1:1), and the component A and the component B are subjected to condensation reaction to form a three-dimensional network structure.

The aqueous binder provided by the embodiment of the invention is used in the negative electrode of the lithium battery, and the component B in the aqueous binder adsorbs the silicon-based negative electrode material of the negative electrode through hydrogen bonds and coats the surface of the silicon-based negative electrode material to form a passivation layer.

Specifically, the component A specifically comprises one or more of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, polyacrylic acid, sodium alginate, polyvinyl alcohol and carboxymethyl chitosan.

The component B comprises one or more of tartaric acid, citric acid, oxalic acid, fumaric acid, maleic acid and malic acid.

The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of the water-based adhesive, as shown in fig. 1, which specifically comprises the following steps:

step 110, preparing the component A into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 1% -5%, then adding a certain amount of the component B, heating and stirring through a water bath, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution;

Wherein the component A is a polymer containing carboxyl and hydroxyl in molecular formula, and specifically comprises one or more of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, polyacrylic acid, sodium alginate, polyvinyl alcohol and carboxymethyl chitosan

The component B is small molecular organic acid containing carboxyl or hydroxyl in molecular formula, and specifically comprises one or more of tartaric acid, citric acid, oxalic acid, fumaric acid, maleic acid and malic acid;

the mass ratio of the component A to the component B in the mixed solution is (1:9) - (9:1);

The heating and stirring conditions in the water bath are that the heating temperature is 85-95 ℃ and the time is 6-10 hours.

Step 120, placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, and drying in a vacuum drying oven to obtain a blocky precursor;

wherein the drying treatment is carried out in a vacuum drying oven at 90-120 ℃ for 5-8 hours.

Step 130, putting the blocky precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain a water-based binder;

wherein, the grinding and sieving in the preparation method of the invention are all conventional methods known in the prior art.

The embodiment of the invention provides a negative electrode containing the water-based binder, which is prepared by preparing the water-based binder, a negative electrode active material and a conductive agent together by the preparation method, coating the negative electrode slurry on a negative electrode current collector, drying and cutting to obtain the negative electrode.

The negative electrode active material is a silicon-based negative electrode material, and specifically comprises any one of nano silicon, a silicon-carbon composite material and silicon oxide, the conductive agent comprises one or more of acetylene black, carbon nano tube, ketjen black, conductive graphite and graphene, and the mass percentage of the negative electrode active material, the conductive agent and the water-based binder is [80% -95% ] [3% -10% ] [2% -10% ].

The embodiment of the invention provides a lithium battery, which comprises a positive electrode, the negative electrode, electrolyte or solid electrolyte and a diaphragm, and comprises any one of a lithium ion battery, a lithium sulfur battery and an all-solid battery.

Wherein the positive electrode active material in the positive electrode comprises any one of lithium iron phosphate, lithium cobalt oxide, lithium manganate, lithium sulfide, lithium nickel cobalt manganate and sulfur-carbon compound.

The electrolyte or the solid electrolyte and the diaphragm are all conventional materials which are known in the prior art.

The aqueous binder is applied to a lithium battery, so that the first-week coulomb efficiency and the cycle stability of the lithium battery can be effectively improved.

In order to better understand the technical scheme provided by the invention, the preparation process and the characteristics of the water-based adhesive are respectively described in the following specific examples.

Example 1

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing sodium carboxymethylcellulose into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 1%, then adding tartaric acid, heating and stirring in a water bath at 90 ℃ for 6 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose to tartaric acid is 1:1.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 90 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 8 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The water-based adhesive prepared in this example was used to prepare a negative electrode tab and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the specific procedure was as follows.

Dissolving a water-based binder in deionized water, adding a silicon-carbon composite material and a conductive agent acetylene black after the water-based binder is completely dissolved to prepare a negative electrode slurry, wherein the silicon-carbon composite material (with the capacity of 550 mAh/g) and the water-based binder and the conductive agent acetylene black are mixed in a mass ratio of 90:7:3, stirring the negative electrode slurry in a stirrer for 6 hours, coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil, then placing the copper foil coated with the negative electrode slurry in a vacuum drying oven, drying at 80 ℃ for 8 hours, drying, taking out, and cutting the copper foil into wafers with the diameter of 12mm by a cutting machine to prepare the negative electrode.

A lithium sheet with a diameter of 12mm was used as a positive electrode, a solution of 1mol/L of Li PF 6 in Ethylene Carbonate (EC)/diethyl carbonate (DEC) (the volume ratio of EC to DEC is 1:1) was used as an electrolyte, and a polypropylene separator was used as a separator to assemble a CR2032 type button cell in an argon-filled glove box (H 2O＜0.01ppm,O2 <0.01 ppm).

The assembled CR2032 button cell was subjected to a cycle performance test by a blue electrical test system with an initial activation current density of 0.1C and a working voltage range of 0.005-1.5V, followed by a long cycle test at a current density of 0.5C.

The initial efficiency and the cycle capacity retention test data of the button cell prepared in this example are shown in table 1.

Example 2

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing polyacrylic acid into 2% aqueous solution by mass, adding citric acid, heating and stirring in 95 ℃ water bath for 5 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of the polyacrylic acid to the citric acid is 3:1.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a vacuum drying oven at 80 ℃ for drying for 10 hours, and taking out the container to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode tab was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, with the same procedure as in example 1.

Example 3

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing carboxymethyl chitosan into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 2.5%, then adding maleic acid, heating and stirring for 7 hours in a water bath at the temperature of 95 ℃, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of the carboxymethyl chitosan to the maleic acid is 1:4.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 100 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 6 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode tab was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, with the same procedure as in example 1.

Example 4

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing polyvinyl alcohol into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 5%, then adding fumaric acid, heating and stirring in a water bath at 100 ℃ for 4 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of the polyvinyl alcohol to the fumaric acid is 1:5.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 95 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 6 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode tab was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, with the same procedure as in example 1.

Example 5

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing sodium carboxymethylcellulose into 2% aqueous solution by mass, adding maleic acid, heating and stirring in a 95 ℃ water bath for 8 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose to maleic acid is 5:4.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 100 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 8 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode tab was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, with the same procedure as in example 1.

Example 6

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing carboxymethyl chitosan into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 2.5%, then adding maleic acid, heating and stirring in a water bath at 90 ℃ for 6 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of the carboxymethyl chitosan to the maleic acid is 1:4.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 100 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 6 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode tab was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, with the same procedure as in example 1.

Example 7

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing sodium carboxymethylcellulose into 2% aqueous solution by mass, adding tartaric acid, heating and stirring in a water bath at 90 ℃ for 8 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose to tartaric acid is 1:1.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, placing the container into a 100 ℃ vacuum drying oven, drying for 8 hours, and taking out to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The negative electrode sheet was prepared using the aqueous binder prepared in this example and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the specific procedure was the same as in example 1, except that the negative electrode active material used in the preparation of the negative electrode sheet was silica (capacity 1650 mAh/g), and initial efficiency and cyclic capacity retention test data were as shown in table 1.

Example 8

The embodiment provides a preparation process and performance test of a water-based binder, wherein the specific preparation process is as follows:

(1) Preparing sodium carboxymethylcellulose into an aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 1%, then adding maleic acid, heating and stirring in a water bath at 100 ℃ for 8 hours, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the mass ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose to maleic acid is 2:1.

(2) And (3) placing the mixed solution in a container with a polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, drying the container in a vacuum drying oven at a temperature of 100 ℃ for 8 hours, and taking out the container to obtain a blocky precursor.

(3) And (3) putting the block-shaped precursor into a mortar for grinding and sieving to obtain the water-based adhesive.

The water-based adhesive prepared in this example was used to prepare a negative electrode sheet and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell for testing, and the specific procedure was the same as in example 1, except that the negative electrode active material used in the preparation of the negative electrode sheet was a nano-silicon material having a particle size Dv50 of 100nm, and initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1.

To better illustrate the effect of the examples of the present invention, comparative example 1 was compared with examples 1 to 6, comparative example 2 was compared with example 7, and comparative example 3 was compared with example 8.

Comparative example 1

This comparative example was tested using a conventional binder PVDF to prepare a negative electrode tab and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell, and the initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1, in the same manner as in example 1.

Comparative example 2

This comparative example was tested using a conventional binder PVDF to prepare a negative electrode tab and assembled into a CR2032 type coin cell, and the negative electrode active material was similarly prepared using silica as in example 7, and initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1.

Comparative example 3

This comparative example was tested using a conventional binder PVDF prepared negative electrode tab and assembled into a CR2032 type button cell, and the negative electrode active material was also a nano-silicon material having a particle size Dv50 of 100nm in the same manner as in example 8, and initial efficiency and cycle capacity retention test data are shown in table 1.

Table 1 shows the test data of the assembled batteries of the binders prepared in examples 1 to 8 and comparative examples 1 to 3, namely, the initial cycle coulombic efficiency of the button half cell, and the capacity retention after 100 cycles and 200 cycles, which are summarized below.

TABLE 1

As can be seen from the comparison of the data in table 1, the first week coulomb efficiency of the batteries of examples 1 to 6 was improved compared to the batteries of comparative examples 1 to 3, the first week coulomb efficiency of the battery of example 7 was better than that of comparative example 2, and the first week coulomb efficiency of the battery of example 8 was better than that of comparative example 3, wherein the improvement was more pronounced in example 8 compared to comparative example 3, because the exposure of silicon particles was more pronounced for the pure nano-silicon material, and therefore the adsorption coating passivation effect of the small molecule acid to the silicon particles was more pronounced, and therefore the first week coulomb efficiency of the battery of example 8 was relatively improved. The batteries of examples 1-8 all have higher cycle capacity retention than the batteries of comparative examples 1-3 because, on one hand, the small molecule acid and the polymer can form a bonding network with a large number of "suckers", i.e., hydrogen bonds, and the small molecule acid adsorbs the silicon oxide layer on the surface of the silicon-based negative electrode material through the hydrogen bonds and coats the silicon oxide layer on the surface of the silicon-based negative electrode material to form a passivation layer, thereby avoiding or reducing the formation of a solid electrolyte interface film (SEI) by direct contact of silicon in the silicon-based negative electrode material with electrolyte, and further improving cycle performance, and on the other hand, the polymer can provide a strong and hard skeleton required by the bonding network, avoiding deformation or even pulverization of the electrode due to the volume stress generated by the active material. The results show that the battery adopting the water-based binder provided by the embodiment of the invention has improved initial cycle coulombic efficiency and cycle stability, wherein the effect is more obvious when the anode active material is nano-silicon.

The foregoing description of the embodiments has been provided for the purpose of illustrating the general principles of the invention, and is not meant to limit the scope of the invention, but to limit the invention to the particular embodiments, and any modifications, equivalents, improvements, etc. that fall within the spirit and principles of the invention are intended to be included within the scope of the invention.
